name: hic_sign
about: Number sign floating over a head, orange when smoking
code:
def hic_sign(ch, n='1', smoke=False):
    r = empty(ch.name + '_hsign', (0, 0, 2.2), parent=ch.head)
    box(ch.name + '_hsb', (1.6, 0.12, 0.9), (0, 0, 0), mat('hsign_bg', hexc('#ff5a3a' if smoke else '#fff3c4'), 0.5), 0.05, parent=r)
    text(ch.name + '_hst', n, (0, -0.1, -0.2), 0.7, mat('hsign_tx', hexc('#202020'), 0.5), parent=r)
    return r
